about: The introitus of the formulary “14th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Our Protector, behold, O God, and regard the face of Your Christ; for a single day in Your courts is better than thousands. How beloved are Your dwellings, O Lord of hosts! My soul longs and faints for the courts of the Lord. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Our Protector, behold, O God, and regard the face of Your Christ; for a single day in Your courts is better than thousands.
